analysis.session_summary: The session was dominated by broad USD strength (+0.208% basket mean) despite a PPI miss that briefly weakened the dollar by 0.062%. AUD (-0.218%) and CHF (-0.215%) were the weakest, while CAD (+0.154%) and JPY (+0.112%) held firm. The VIX rose 9.324% to 19.639, underscoring risk-off undertones, but most major legs lacked identifiable catalysts. USD/CHF and USD/SEK closed at or near their highs, reflecting USD momentum.

themes.theme: Broad USD strength despite PPI miss
themes.evidence: USD strength +0.208% closed at best; PPI miss only -0.062%; DXY +0.172% to 103.297.

themes.theme: CAD and JPY outperform in core
themes.evidence: CAD +0.154% held range; JPY +0.112% closed at best; USD/CAD only +6.8 pips.
USD PPI 0.3% vs 0.4% forecast: USD weaker 0.062%; top movers AUD/USD +14.4 pips, Gold +243.3; but USD recovered.

currency_drivers.USD: PPI miss briefly weakened USD 0.062%, but it closed at its best with no single catalyst.
currency_drivers.EUR: Lagarde speech was muted; an early +0.15% attempt was rejected, giving back 89%.
currency_drivers.JPY: No own catalyst; closed at its best, consistent with safe-haven demand.
currency_drivers.GBP: No own catalyst; held its range with modest firmness.
currency_drivers.AUD: No own catalyst; weakest major, attempt rejected with 80% of its early gain retraced.
currency_drivers.CAD: No own catalyst; held its range and closed firm.
currency_drivers.CHF: No own catalyst; attempt rejected, gave back 100% of its early advance.
currency_drivers.NZD: No own catalyst; soft risk appetite weighed on the currency.

leg_notes.EUR/USD: EUR/USD's early 16.4-pip rise had no clear catalyst and was fully reversed by a 39.6-pip decline, leaving it near lows with no news-driven driver.

polarity_reads.read: Normal bearish USD impulse was quickly absorbed; USD closed at its best, suggesting positioning still favors USD.
Muted inside noise floor; no EUR positioning signal from speech.

scenarios.name: USD strength extends
scenarios.thesis: USD closed at its best after absorbing the PPI dip; DXY closed at its 1.0 range high and VIX is elevated, leaving dollar momentum intact.
triggers: CAD CPI not hot enough to lift CAD
scenarios.invalidation: A decisive close below 1.10278 in EUR/USD signals the PPI dip is being reasserted.

GBP/USD range 45.8 pips; GBP held range but USD bid persists.
AUD/USD range 42.9 pips; weakest major in risk-off tone.
USD/JPY range 51.7 pips; JPY strength limited but USD momentum dominates.
USD/CHF range 53.7 pips; CHF gave back early advance.

scenarios.name: CAD CPI surprise
scenarios.thesis: Hot CAD CPI would reinforce CAD's held range and push USD/CAD lower; CAD had no own catalyst and is sensitive to upcoming data.
scenarios.invalidation: Soft CPI or broadly stronger USD pushes USD/CAD above 1.42647.

scenarios.name: Risk-off accelerates
scenarios.thesis: VIX rose 9.324% to 19.639; safe havens CHF/JPY bid while commodity FX remain vulnerable; USD may weaken against yen/franc but stay supported elsewhere.
scenarios.invalidation: VIX drops back and USD/CHF holds above 0.83945.

USD/CHF range 53.7 pips; safe-haven franc retakes early advance.

EUR/CHF range 48.6 pips; franc strength against euro.

risks.risk: USD strength is broad and at the top of its range
risks.why_it_matters: It can override local data like the PPI miss; any hawkish Fed Warsh speaks could extend it.
VIX +9.324% and weak AUD/CHF may fuel safe-haven flows, hurting carry and commodity FX.
